newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Exploration names pres, CEO, chairman.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Exploration names pres, CEO, chairman.

text.p: United States Exploration Inc said late Monday that Bruce Benson has been named president, chief executive and chairman.
The company said it that under its agreement in hiring Benson, the remaining officers and directors of the company have resigned and have been replaced.
It did not name those officers or their successors, and was not immediately available for comment.

In a statement issued by the company, Benson said the company is relocating its headquarters to Denver, Colo., it has closed its supply store and it is selling the assets of the servicing business, including drilling rigs.
"We intend to accelerate the process of streamlining the company's operation and rapidly disposing of unnecessary assets which was commenced by prior management," he said.

The agreement with Benson is effective for a three-year term. Under the agreement, he will be compensated with a combination of salary and stock options exercisable at various prices escalating from $4.50 per share, the company said.
Benson will continue in his capacity as president of Benson Mineral Group Inc, a privately-held Oklahoma company, United States Exploration said.
In conjunction with this transaction, Benson has acquired 220,000 shares of the company's common stock in a private transaction.
United States Exploration is an independent producer of oil and gas and operator of numerous gas gathering systems.
